column1: # D-582: German chat golden set - one curated chat case per line, TAB-separated.
#   1 category   grouping for the per-category metrics (see the harness KDoc)
#   2 mode       chip     - composing token, suggestionsFor() ranking (the bar while typing)
#                  silent   - the silent-correction decision path at commit
#                  nextword - blank-slate prediction after the committed context (no token typed)
#   3 typed      the composing token exactly as typed (for nextword: '-')
#   4 previous   most recently committed word (lowercase, '-' when none)
#   5 previous2  the word before that ('-' when none)
#   6 expected   the word the case wants, lowercase (canonical store form compared
#                case-insensitively; '-' when none for no_silent cases)
#   7 kind       hit      - the case wants `expected` (chip slot / silent replacement /
#                  next-word slot; the harness measures hit@1/@3/@12 or the silent replacement)
#                no_silent - safety class: the path must NOT silently correct the token
#                  (typed word is correct, rare-but-real, or deliberately left alone)
# Gap categories (gap_lexicon, contraction, and the explicitly-listed nextword_chat gaps) are
# measured and printed for the D-582 baseline but carry no floor yet - M3 (D-583) must lift the
# lexicon/contraction gaps, M4 (D-584) the next-word chat contexts; each round pins its own
